title: Superheated magma could fuel towering lava fountains
caption:
A hidden heat boost can keep magma liquid for hours, letting it shoot lava high into the sky. Lab experiments on La Palma samples showed crystal formation delayed from minutes to over eight hours. This adds a new piece to the puzzle of why volcanoes sometimes erupt dramatically.

Source: Sciencedaily - Superheated magma could fuel towering lava fountains

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261111221811.htm
